controller_responsibilities.fact_index: assigns one unique fact_ref to every pre-existing packet entry (source/obs/field/shape/route) and every supplemental fact; refs are the only way the model may cite evidence
validates: every injected-kind ref (source_ref/observation_ref/fact_ref/binding_ref) resolves to an injected identity of the matching kind
exactly one source_decision per injected source_ref and exactly one observation_decision per injected observation_ref: none missing, none duplicated, none added

scenario_candidate.local_id and evidence_request.id are response-local IDs defined by this output: each unique within the output, never validated against injected identity sets, never treated as injected identities or approved operation ids
every scenario_refs entry resolves to a local_id defined in this output; every open_request_ids entry resolves to an evidence_request.id defined in this output

provenance alignment: observation_refs belong to the declared source_refs; fact_refs support the relevant source(s) or an explicitly supplied cross-source relation; relationship.kind=existing target_binding_ref matches the supplied binding context, not merely any existing id
input pins echoed by the model output are not required and not trusted; controller re-checks pins itself
derived counts are recomputed by the controller; model output is never a fact store

classification_candidates.note: categories without supporting facts MUST remain uncertain; an open_request_id is not evidence and cannot substitute for a fact-backed positive classification

assessment.note: free-text judgment only; MUST NOT introduce new HTTP method/path/parameter/JSON-shape/field-count/validation-state claims

local_id.note: local identifier only; NOT an approved operation id

scenario_proposal.note: design proposal / open question text; must not be phrased as official fact

target_binding_ref.rule: when kind=existing it MUST match an injected binding_ref; self-minted approved operation IDs are rejected; when kind!=existing it MUST be null

official_fact_refs.rule: exact picks from injected fact_refs only; no free-text facts

requested_safe_fact.rule: bounded single fact; MUST NOT request raw text, code bodies, or concrete values

protocol_freeze.rule: unknown path or unadjudicated required parameters keep protocol_freeze_blocker
protocol_freeze.non_rule: absence of authorization is NOT automatically a protocol blocker

identity_conservation: exactly one source_decision per injected source_ref; an uncertain decision may carry open_request_ids but no injected source may be missing, duplicated, or added
exactly one observation_decision per injected observation_ref
no duplicate scenario_candidate.local_id within the output; no duplicate evidence_request.id within the output (local uniqueness, not conservation against injected sets)
every relationship.kind=existing target resolves to an injected binding_ref matching the supplied binding context
reference_integrity: all source_ref/observation_ref/fact_ref/binding_ref fields resolve to injected identities of the matching kind
all scenario_refs resolve to a local_id defined in this output; all open_request_ids resolve to an evidence_request.id defined in this output
classification_fact_refs and official_fact_refs contain only injected fact_refs
observation_refs belong to the declared source_refs; fact_refs support the relevant source(s) or an explicitly supplied cross-source relation

minimal_counterexamples.input_summary: model returns a scenario_candidate whose official_fact_refs contains 'fact-999' not present in fact_index
model marks a source_decision classification_candidates=['server_api'] while the observation has no verified path and no open_request_id
minimal_counterexamples.expected_controller_verdict: reject: path unknown, no bounded evidence request; protocol_freeze_blocker must remain

minimal_counterexamples.input_summary: model assessment claims a field_table or code shape proves the full response schema / success code / version branch
minimal_counterexamples.expected_controller_verdict: reject: context/shape facts may only anchor position; model must not assert complete schema from them

minimal_counterexamples.input_summary: source_decision emits classification_candidates=['server_api'] with empty classification_fact_refs and empty open_request_ids
minimal_counterexamples.expected_controller_verdict: reject: a category without supporting facts must stay 'uncertain'; attaching an open_request_id does not authorize a positive classification
reject: unresolvable binding_ref; self-minted approved operation ids forbidden
